_comment: Multi-account configuration for Anthropic OAuth Bridge.
_docs: Add accounts via the built-in PKCE flow: POST /auth/login → authorize in browser → POST /auth/exchange (with api_key). Or manually: POST /auth/save-tokens.
_docs_flow:
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:64173/auth/login | jq    # get auth_url + code_verifier
# Open auth_url in browser, authorize, copy code from redirect URL
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:64173/auth/exchange -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"session_id":"...","code":"...","api_key":"sk-myaccount","label":"My Account"}'
